failures.root_cause: sed command references TEST_TEMP_DIR variable that was not expanded before being passed as the sed script argument, causing sed to treat the literal string as a file path
failures.fix: ensure TEST_TEMP_DIR is exported or properly quoted so it expands inside the sed expression, or use a different substitution approach

failures.root_cause: sed command references a variable $TEST_TEMP_DIR that is not expanded before being used as a filename instead of a sed expression
failures.fix: quote the sed expression correctly and ensure the variable substitution happens in the shell before passing to sed, e.g. use sed "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g" instead of sed 's|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g'
